title.narrative: Youths as Agents of Positive Change Using Sports and Interactive Media

description.narrative:
The aim of this project is to support the communities of Korogocho, Kenya.
St.Johns Sports Society (SSS) based at St. John's sub - parish of Kariobangi has worked with communities of Korogocho slums in Nairobi for over 20 years. In this project, SSS proposes to take forward and consolidate the gains of the partnership it has had with CAFOD since 2008 in supporting communities in Korogocho mainly through Sports, arts and cultural performances aimed at mobilizing youth towards constructive use of their skills and talents for justice and peace.
For the next three years, SSS will continue recruiting youths into the various sporting teams. These sports teams are strategically the change agents within Korogocho slums. The team members will be organised and capacity built on advocacy on Peace Building and Advocacy skills. A representation of selected team members will be built and will be engaged as Community Education and Leadership teams though advocacy on governance, justice and peace building. These teams will particularly be involved in public expenditure monitoring (monitoring of public resources allocation and utilisation) and civic education.
Further, media programmes (electronic and print) will be used as a strategy for public awareness and advocacy. Realizing the poverty levels of the communities in Korogocho, SSS will identify and support members of its sports teams annually to undertake vocational trainings.
